description: This file defines functions and constants related to CRC32 checksum calculations, including various algorithms and optimizations such as slicing-by-4, slicing-by-8, and slicing-by-16. It also declares lookup tables for efficient computation.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_fast(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32)
methods.description: Computes CRC32 using the fastest available algorithm for large datasets, selecting among slicing-by-16, slicing-by-8, slicing-by-4, or tableless implementation based on compile-time definitions.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_combine(uint32_t crcA,uint32_t crcB,size_t lengthB)
methods.description: Merges two CRC32 checksums, allowing for concatenation of data streams efficiently.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_bitwise(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32)
methods.description: Computes CRC32 using the bitwise algorithm, suitable for small data or environments where lookup tables are not used.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_halfbyte(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32)
methods.description: Computes CRC32 using a half-byte lookup table, offering a trade-off between speed and memory usage.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_1byte(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32)
methods.description: Standard CRC32 calculation using a lookup table for one-byte slices, enabled only if CRC32_USE_LOOKUP_TABLE_BYTE is defined.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_1byte_tableless(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32)
methods.description: CRC32 calculation without lookup tables, processing data byte-by-byte.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_1byte_tableless2(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32)
methods.description: An alternative tableless CRC32 implementation, using a different algorithm for byte processing.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_4bytes(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32)
methods.description: CRC32 calculation using slicing-by-4 algorithm, enabled if CRC32_USE_LOOKUP_TABLE_SLICING_BY_4 is defined.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_8bytes(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32)
methods.description: CRC32 calculation with slicing-by-8 algorithm, optimized for faster processing of larger chunks, enabled if CRC32_USE_LOOKUP_TABLE_SLICING_BY_8 is defined.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_16bytes(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32)
methods.description: CRC32 calculation with slicing-by-16 algorithm, for high-performance processing of very large data blocks, enabled if CRC32_USE_LOOKUP_TABLE_SLICING_BY_16 is defined.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_16bytes_prefetch(const void * data,size_t length,uint32_t previousCrc32,size_t prefetchAhead)
methods.description: Enhanced CRC32 calculation with slicing-by-16 and prefetching, for improved cache performance.
